player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Acie path; ku yïn alëu ba wɛ̈tdu bɛ̈n lɛ̈k kɔc ë [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Guess adhil tɔ̈u në kaam de {min_guess} ku {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 guessed {guess0}; Player 1 guessed {guess1}. Thus the Target is: {target}.
message.round_draw: Thëm ee kë ye kɔc thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ.
message.round_win: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {winner} ee cï tɔŋ bɛ̈n tiaam!

outcome.p0_wins: Raan ye 0 ke yen acï wëu juëc bɛ̈n yök.
outcome.p1_wins: Raan ye 1 acï wëu juëc bɛ̈n tiaam.
outcome.draw: Në ye mɛn, ke kɔc acï bɛ̈n mat.
